title: 企业注册认证

red.reason: POST /v1/enterprise/registrations was expected to fail closed with 503 before an external verifier was configured, but the route returned 404 before implementation.

invariants: 江苏福礼团供应链科技有限公司 remains the sole merchant and companyId is derived on the server.
Enterprise ownership and the active company functional account are derived from signed credentials or verified sessions, never client owner fields.
The default phone verifier fails closed with SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE and performs zero writes.
Natural-person identity separation prevents the submitter from approving the same certification through another functional account.
Idempotency, credit-code uniqueness and optimistic versions prevent duplicate or concurrent certification decisions.
Certification snapshots and status history are append-only; rejected transitions produce no partial write.
Customer-facing DTOs never return supply price and mask mobile, credit code, tax number and bank account.
The registration page is dynamic, noindex and private/no-store; credentials are stored only in browser sessionStorage.
knownFailedRuns: The first full verify failed in the frozen OpenAPI path list after the six additive enterprise registration routes were generated.
The next regression run found historical gate tests still pinned to M3-P027 and PR 88 evidence.
A later full verify passed 16 of 17 steps and failed only because the secret scanner interpreted a Symbol dependency-injection name as a credential assignment.
All three causes were corrected without deleting tests or weakening business assertions; the final committed code head passed all 17 steps.
notExecuted: EXT-013 contract, agreement, bank-transfer and invoice legal/finance acceptance
real SMS and object-storage provider accounts
P0-077 full preview, durable progress, field-correction and suspension user experience
Excel execution-pack mirror update because the mandatory Spreadsheet skill operation marker is unavailable
risk: The local verifier and object references prove only technical behavior. They do not prove real SMS delivery, document custody, legal approval, bank-transfer verification or invoice compliance.
rollback: Revert the M3-P028 application, migration, generated contract, tests and ledger commits. If MIG-011 has been applied outside disposable local databases, deploy a forward corrective migration and preserve append-only certification evidence; do not edit published migration SQL or delete audit history.
nextGate: Create a Draft PR, verify its exact-head Actions and unresolved comments, then wait for explicit exact-head Ready/merge authorization. M3-P029 remains locked until post-merge main CI succeeds.
